tool.name: gatk4_unmarkduplicates
tool.description: This tool locates and unmark the marked duplicate reads in a BAM or SAM file, where duplicate reads are defined as originating from a single fragment of DNA.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**gatk4_unmarkduplicates**
This tool locates and unmark the marked duplicate reads in a BAM or SAM file, where duplicate reads are defined as originating from a single fragment of DNA.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: gatk4/unmarkduplicates - Container: biocontainers/gatk4:4.6.2.0
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
